name: UNDYING: Kowloon in Red
source:
You came here bright and joyful, following your husband from Scotland to his post on Hong Kong island.

Months later, you are bloodied, cold, starving, lost in Kowloon. Missing posters bearing your face fray at the edges and you don’t recognise yourself anymore.

When you smell blood - a potential meal -, you find a local on the verge of death. After feeding on his attackers, you’re offered a job.

Survive as a young, lost vampire in Kowloon and navigate its dark depths, but beware; you're not the only thing that lurks within them.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/undying-kowloon-in-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你带着你的丈夫从苏格兰来到香港岛任职，心情愉快，心情愉悦。

几个月后，你在九龙流血、寒冷、饥饿、迷失。丢失的海报上印着你的脸，边缘已经磨损，你再也认不出自己了。

当你闻到血腥味（可能是一顿饭）时，你会发现当地人濒临死亡。在以攻击者为食后，你会得到一份工作。

作为一个年轻的、迷失的吸血鬼在九龙生存并在黑暗的深处航行，但要小心；你并不是唯一潜伏在他们内心的东西。

[来自[url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/undying-kowloon-in-red]itch.io[/url]]
